title: SET UP VISUAL-NOTES
subtitle: A user's recipe: install once, then just ask for notes

cols.title: Before you start
items: **Python 3** on the machine that runs the skill
No PDF engine? You get a printable HTML page instead

cols.title: Analogy: a new recipe card
cols.text: Installing adds a card to the agent's binder. It reads only the **label** (description) until you ask for notes, then opens the card and follows it.

cols.title: Install from the terminal
cols.code:
# Claude Code: add the marketplace once, then install the plugin
/plugin marketplace add BinayakDotel/skills-marketplace
/plugin install visual-notes@binayak-skills

# Any agent (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot…): the skills CLI
npx skills add BinayakDotel/skills-marketplace --list
npx skills add BinayakDotel/skills-marketplace --skill visual-notes -a claude-code -g
cols.caption: `-g` = install for every project; drop it to install into the current project only.

cols.title: claude.ai / Claude desktop
items: Switch the skill on; Claude Code sessions sync it too

cols.title: By hand (any agent)
items: Copy `skills/visual-notes/` into your agent's skills folder
Start a new session so the agent sees it

items.desc: reads only the pages it needs

cols.title: If it goes wrong
text: **no closing ---** on upload -> wrong zip; use the one the script built.
**HTML, not PDF** -> install Chrome or wkhtmltopdf.
**Not triggering** -> check it is enabled, or call `/visual-notes`.
**Old behaviour on claude.ai** -> remove the old skill, upload the new zip.

cols.title: Quick revision points
groups: claude.ai: upload the ==zip==, code execution on.
Needs Python 3 + Chrome for the PDF.
Output: a PDF + its spec (HTML if no PDF engine).
